subject: dxf: fix metering might be lost when failed to write, and refactor (#64358)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff vs parent focusing on DDL add-index DXF execution and metering. The refactor switches to per-task in-memory recorders with delta-based flush (no data drop on write failure), wires recorder access through StepExecFrameworkInfo, unregisters recorders when task executors exit, and clears the global metering instance when the domain’s flush loop stops; no Blocker/High correctness, consistency, concurrency, or DDL metadata/state-machine issues found in the touched paths.
